text: #857 was finished by hand after the factory's build stopped on standing tests, and three independent reviews found what the plan doesn't state. An amendment keeps a bug its lock leaves unclassified exactly as the lock has it, and classifies each bug it adds or changes: requiring every bug of every draft to be classified refused the factory's own seed of any lock from before the rule. The lock's statements travel in the check context, so the drafting agent's checker holds a draft to the same rule. A replay path is refused, with the step named, rather than guessed: when no single operation takes a step, as when a bug's operation can take a step an action of Next takes too; when the operation that takes a step could have reached another state with the same arguments, which TLC decides at the step's own state; when a step binds a variable named like a constant or a model value; and when the model defines Cardinality, Len or PrintT itself. A saved preview's fingerprint is made from its receipt's evidence and coverage view, verify.Report.SavedJSON, and from no view added since, so a preview saved before a bug had a replay status still reads as itself. A proposal that calls a bug current where a driver checks the code says, in its comment and on its card, that it can't be built until the gate can run a replay, and an amendment says which bugs it stops calling current. A replay's records are compared by the values they hold, and a replay isn't called complete without its request, result and observation. A draft's own check doesn't prepare a replay path yet (#910). Refines D-0470.
